fallbacks.next: write manual search URLs and continue
rotate to next API provider, reduce count, keep query pending
do not fetch; keep URL/title/snippet metadata only
store source metadata and require manual/PDF-specific extraction
hold for manual review; do not generate public facts automatically
generate prompts only from placeholders and source-level metadata
create conflict-resolution prompt instead of a new fact

politeness.concurrency: Prefer per-host serial fetches; broaden by query/source family rather than hammering one host.
politeness.crawl_delay: Use robots crawl-delay when present; otherwise default to at least 2 seconds per host.
politeness.robots_txt: Check before page fetch; keep blocked URLs as metadata-only candidates.
politeness.user_agent: DueCareResearchSpider/0.1 (public-source benchmark proposals; no private case ingestion)

privacy.raw_private_cases: Never send raw private case text to search providers.
privacy.search_queries: Use public seed labels and behavior terms, not names, phone numbers, document IDs, or exact private locations.
privacy.snippets: Redact email, phone-like, passport-like, and SSN-like strings before writing artifacts.
